title: Next Greater Element II
goal: Solve Next Greater Element II: Given a circular integer array nums, return the next greater number for every element. The next greater number of x is the first greater number to its traversing order next, searching circularly; if it does not exist, return -1.
strategy: Given a circular integer array nums, return the next greater number for every element. The next greater number of x is the first greater number to its traversing order next, searching circularly; if it does not exist, return -1.
edgeCases: A circular second pass may resolve pending indices but must not append duplicate answer positions.
inputRules: Keep the array to 16 elements or fewer
